items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: I don't know whether Barney Bigard is white or not, or Juan Tizol.

ctx.x: And he walked out, he didn't go back for three days. Just out of solidarity of friendship. I kept telling him, don't be silly, you know, I understand how he feels in the first place, and he's got a stinky day because it's ridiculous for him to say he didn't want white guys in the band, because I don't know whether Barney Bigard is white or not, or Juan Tizol.
